name: Ontology Bridge
description: Unified memory bridge: ontology keyword match + shared ChromaDB semantic search + orchestrator recent messages. Injects relevant context into agent prompts and extracts facts back to ontology.

orchestratorUrl.description: Orchestrator API URL for recent messages (default: http://127.0.0.1:5000)

defaultSpeakerId.description: Default X-Speaker-Id for ontology API calls (default: jarvis-agent)

cacheRefreshIntervalMs.description: How often to refresh the entity cache in ms (default: 300000 = 5 min)

maxContextTokens.description: Max approximate tokens for total injected context (default: 600)

recentMessagesCount.description: Number of recent orchestrator messages to fetch (default: 6)

extractionEnabled.description: Enable automatic fact extraction from conversations (default: true)
